api.success: Derived denominator, per-role IDs, full wire counts, peer/recovery completion rows, typed refusals with retry and spanning-peer IDs, and complete generation census; no passed or qualification boolean.
api.required: One overload_recovery cell returned by serving_manifest.required_cells with independently trusted bytes and release scope; exact four true requirement flags.
api.program: Exact cell_id, scope, server_identity, mode=overload_then_recovery, requests. Each request has id/role/model/wire/path/payload. peer/recovery additionally have inclusive positive prompt_tokens and completion_tokens ranges. refused instead has one frozen error_code in shed_queue/shed_deadline/shed_queue_wait. 3..256 requests, at least one per role.
api.observations: All planned IDs exactly once. Requests carry POST/path/server_identity/timestamps/status/body bytes/raw response headers/optional transport_error; health carries unique id, GET /health, same identity, timestamps, status200 and raw status=ok/worker.generation. Complete before/after health brackets for every request including refusal.
api.ordering: Every refusal is strictly spanned by at least one clean peer client interval. All recovery captures start strictly after all peer/refused captures finish. Same worker generation throughout all health samples, including between phases.

source_contracts.contract: reserve_pending_admit_with_ceiling: queue-bound/deadline/wait-ceiling branches return 429 rate_limit_error with shed_queue/shed_deadline/shed_queue_wait, retry estimate supplied.
error_body has message/type/param/code; these three queue branches supply param=None.
context_length_exceeded is400; quota rate_limit_exceeded is429; overloaded is503. They do not prove the selected queue scenario.
Retry-After canonical decimal seconds clamped1..60; retry-after-ms exactlyseconds*1000. overloaded503 is also used for worker unavailability.
Normal health is status200/status=ok; draining is also200 but distinct, unhealthy503 is refused by this predicate.

false_acceptance_controls: missing/duplicate/empty/unplanned IDs and missing role denominator
valid-looking bytes with client cancel/transport read failure
200 with missing/truncated terminal, missing usage or empty output
no spanning peer or late unrelated refusal despite clean_success2/refused1 counts
recovery preceding completion of any pressure request
worker change BETWEEN individually unaffected request phases
missing refusal generation bracket, owner/path/method substitution
weakened required flags and capture-supplied success summaries
limits: Pure synthetic raw-wire CPU fixtures, not native serving execution or release qualification. No GPU, remote job, socket or process startup was performed for this sidecar.

Caller must authenticate independent required scope/manifest, frozen program and all payloads/IDs, actual collector listener/process identity, source/binary/artifacts and card lease. This pure API checks consistency, not provenance.
Only source queue429 codes are accepted. Generic overloaded503 and quota rate_limit_exceeded429 remain unsupported for this queue-specific predicate.
Header clamp and paired units are checked, not the unobserved queue estimate/depth, billing or client adherence to retry delay.
Spanning intervals are client capture observations, not proof of concurrent server/GPU execution or last-write time. No throughput/latency benchmark claim.
Current implementation requires GET metadata on health as well as POST/path/owner metadata on all requests; collector mapping/integration remains parent-owned.
